subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The engineer visited the construction _________- to check the progress of the building.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**site**" refers to a specific location or area, such as a construction site.
 
• The term "**sight**" refers to vision or something that is seen, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The word "**cite**" means to reference something, which is also not suitable in this context.
 
• Option 2 (site.) is grammatically incorrect because there is an unnecessary period at the end.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The engineer visited the construction **site** to check the progress of the building."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **site**: Refers to a location (e.g., construction site).
 
• **sight**: Refers to the ability to see or something seen (e.g., a beautiful sight).
 
• **cite**: Refers to referencing or quoting something (e.g., cite a source).
 
• It is important to choose the word that appropriately matches the context of the sentence.
